run_votenet_demo: run the VoteNet demo to detect 3D objects from a point cloud file using sunrgbd or scannet dataset
preprocess_point_cloud: preprocess a numpy point cloud by removing color, estimating floor height, and sampling to a fixed number of points
build_votenet_model: build a VoteNet 3D object detector model with dataset-specific class, heading bin, and size cluster configuration
load_checkpoint: load a pretrained VoteNet checkpoint containing model weights and optimizer state from a tar file
run_inference_and_dump: run inference on a point cloud with VoteNet, parse predictions, and dump detection results to a directory
